claim_scope: paired synthetic write-routing architecture qualification only; not corpus ANN recall, production-read, or third-party comparison evidence
spot_interruption_policy: sync every terminal arm to S3; discard a nonterminal arm and restart it from a fresh immutable base; never combine samples across attempts
comparison_contract: Both arms use the same clean source archive, Spot instance, centered 768-dimensional cosine vectors (with per-vector BLAKE3 evidence), logical-cell centroid catalog, immutable base, record IDs, separately opened writer instances, writer counts, synchronized measurement start, repetition, operation order, default production in-memory caches, no external disk cache, timeouts, and resource telemetry. Only logical-cell assignment changes. Every terminal arm preserves raw latency samples, exact storage-request reports, storage access trace, process exit, stdout/stderr, and sampled CPU, RSS, VMS, process I/O, disk, and network counters. The 200 ms p95 is a fail-closed hard cap, not an optimization target. Lower latency and higher throughput remain preferred at fixed correctness.
